title: The Sleeping Portrait
author: Casper Almeida
blurb: Mara Zhou, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the family out ahead of the count before the well refills.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
